message: Command `grep -n "m_LinkLayerType\|getLinkLayerType\|linkLayerType" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/Packet.cpp | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The `pcap_datalink()` returns an integer from the pcap file header. This is cast to `LinkLayerType` enum without validation. If the pcap file has an invalid/unexpected link layer type value, the `static_cast<LinkLayerType>(m_PcapLinkLayerType)` on line 175 passes an invalid enum value to `setRawData`, which stores it in `m_LinkLayerType`. Later, when the packet is parsed, this invalid link layer type could cause out-of-bounds access or other memory safety issues.
